about: The one authoritative settings file's schema (M9: docs/M9_LAUNCHER_PLAN.md section 13). The file is <install>/config/dotheroes.cfg, NAME=value lines: the game reads it at start (port/main.cpp), the launcher and the game's own menus read and write it through these rules. owner: who uses the value; applies: 'live' (taken while the game runs) or 'restart' (at the game's next start). M10 adds the remaining PC settings here.

labels.windowed: Windowed (resizable; its size and place remembered)
labels.exclusive: Exclusive fullscreen (where supported; the display's own resolution and refresh rate)

settings.label: Rendering resolution
settings.help: The size the game's picture is drawn at, then scaled to the window or display with its shape kept: above the display's own (sharper, slower) or below it (faster). Independent of the display mode and the window's size; the display's own resolution is never changed.

settings.label: VSync
settings.help: On: frames wait for the display (no tearing). Off: shown at once. Independent of the frame limit.

settings.label: Frame limit
settings.help: The game runs at the same speed at every frame rate.

settings.label: In-game menu shortcut (held)
settings.help: Held half a second. F1 on the keyboard opens it too.

settings.label: Show the in-game menu's shortcut at start
Skip the start-up logos
settings.help: Straight to the title screen. The start-up runs whole, only faster; the new game's opening is kept.

settings.label: Controller bindings
settings.help: Set in the game's menu (Controls): the game's button = the pad's, by their PlayStation names.

settings.label: Keyboard bindings
settings.help: Set in the game's menu (Controls): the game's button = a key.

settings.label: Fullscreen (earlier versions' setting)
settings.help: Kept for files from earlier versions: 1 is borderless until a display mode is chosen.

settings.label: Native collision
settings.help: Holds 60 fps in debris-heavy fights; off: the original's way, slower.

labels.windowed: Windowed (resizable; its size and place remembered)
labels.exclusive: Exclusive fullscreen (where supported; the display's own resolution and refresh rate)

settings.label: Close the launcher when the game starts
settings.help: Return to Launcher in the game's menu opens it again.

settings.label: Button prompts
settings.help: The buttons the launcher and the whole game show: its menus, messages, tutorials and minigames. Your own button and key choices are shown; PlayStation keeps the game's original pictures.

settings.label: Prepare shaders after a game update
Rebuild the shader cache after a GPU or driver change
Check for updates when the launcher starts
Previous game builds kept for rollback
Automatic save backups kept
settings.help: Backups you make yourself are kept until you delete them.

settings.label: Log detail
settings.help: How much the game and the launcher write in their logs. Normal is enough for a report.

settings.label: Developer mode
settings.help: Testing tools in the in-game menu, for developers. While it is on, the game plays on separate test saves: your own saves are not used or changed.
